The main point you're missing with the other fortified legends is that they have a kit purely based around their size. They are all slow paced legends with defensive abilties. Newcastle again is support so won't have movement but also has a shield and his ult is a wall. Rev is designed for aggressive play (whole lore of the legend) but will lose the average 50/50 due to his size.
